evaluations.claim: In the SMD dataset, the green bar reaches approximately 95%, while the purple bar is the shortest, at around 85%.
evaluations.reality: The green bar in the SMD dataset is approximately 93%, and the purple bar is closer to 90%, not 85%.

evaluations.claim: In the SWaT dataset, all bars exceed 90%, and the green bar is the tallest.
evaluations.reality: In the SWaT dataset, the blue and orange bars are below 90%, and the green bar is not the tallest; the purple bar is slightly shorter than the green bar.

evaluations.claim: In the WADI dataset, the green bar is the tallest, at approximately 80%, while the purple bar is the shortest, at around 60%.
evaluations.reality: In the WADI dataset, the green bar is the tallest but only reaches approximately 74%, and the purple bar is the shortest at around 63%.
